replies.author: SGMC
replies.body: The YAML or .yml file in the map is essentially a pretty simple document that gives the plugin running the minigame information like the team names, colors, spawnpoints, etc. It essentially tells the plugin how to run the map and without one it won't work. They have an entire website about how to make one, docs.avicus.net. Once you get the hang of it, it isn't that difficult.
